verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication device, so an event-triggered automation rules engine falls outside its product category. The evidence shows only a scriptable CLI (ykman), SDKs and a fleet-delivery REST API. These are developer building blocks for device management and authentication, not a user-definable rule or trigger capability, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
